import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 15;
    static final int INF = (int)1e9;

    static int n, T;
    static char[][] grid = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] target = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] id = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int total;
    static int[][] distFromZ = new int[MAXN][MAXN];

    static class FlowEdge {
        int to, capacity, flow;
        FlowEdge(int t, int c) {
            to = t;
            capacity = c;
            flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static List<FlowEdge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer>[] graph = new List[3005];

    static void connect(int u, int v, int cap) {
        graph[u].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new FlowEdge(v, cap));
        graph[v].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new FlowEdge(u, 0));
    }

    static boolean bfsLevel(int source, int sink) {
        int[] level = new int[3005];
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(source);
        level[source] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int idx : graph[u]) {
                FlowEdge e = edges.get(idx);
                if (level[e.to] == -1 && e.capacity > e.flow) {
                    level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[sink] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int sink, int flow) {
        if (u == sink || flow == 0) return flow;
        for (int i = 0; i < graph[u].size(); ) {
            int idx = graph[u].get(i);
            FlowEdge e = edges.get(idx);
            if (e.capacity > e.flow) {
                int pushed = dfs(e.to, sink, Math.min(flow, e.capacity - e.flow));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.flow += pushed;
                    edges.get(idx ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
            i++;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic(int source, int sink) {
        int flow = 0;
        while (bfsLevel(source, sink)) {
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfs(source, sink, INF)) > 0) {
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            grid[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            target[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }

        int sx = -1, sy = -1;
        total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                    grid[i][j] = '0';
                }
                id[i][j] = ++total;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(distFromZ[i], 0x3f3f3f3f);
        }
        
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        if (sx != -1 && sy != -1) {
            distFromZ[sx][sy] = 0;
            q.offer(new int[]{sx, sy});
        }
        
        int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
        int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n &&
                    grid[nx][ny] >= '0' && grid[nx][ny] <= '9' &&
                    distFromZ[nx][ny] > distFromZ[x][y] + 1) {
                    distFromZ[nx][ny] = distFromZ[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        int source = 2 * total + 1;
        int sink = source + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < 3005; i++) {
            graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] >= '1' && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    connect(source, id[i][j], grid[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (target[i][j] >= '1' && target[i][j] <= '9') {
                    connect(id[i][j] + total, sink, target[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] >= '1' && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    int[][] dist = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
                    for (int x = 0; x < MAXN; x++) {
                        Arrays.fill(dist[x], 0x3f3f3f3f);
                    }
                    Queue<int[]> localQ = new LinkedList<>();
                    dist[i][j] = 0;
                    localQ.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    while (!localQ.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] cell = localQ.poll();
                        int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
                        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                            int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                            if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n &&
                                grid[nx][ny] >= '0' && grid[nx][ny] <= '9' &&
                                dist[nx][ny] > dist[x][y] + 1) {
                                dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                                localQ.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                            if (target[x][y] >= '1' && target[x][y] <= '9' &&
                                dist[x][y] <= T && dist[x][y] <= distFromZ[x][y]) {
                                connect(id[i][j], id[x][y] + total, INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic(source, sink));
    }
}
